description: These are the SPHERE/IRDIS filter transmissions published by ESO: broad-band, dual-band and narrow-band filters. Each dual-band entry is one channel of the filter ESO lists as a pair.
facility_description: The ESO Very Large Telescope stands at the Paranal Observatory in Chile.
notes: Neutral-density filters and ZIMPOL are separate NJM instruments (SPHERE/IRDIS and SPHERE/ZIMPOL). ESO does not label which dual-band peak belongs to which channel name, so no single central wavelength is assigned to Y2 versus Y3 and the other split channels. Beuzit et al. 2019 is the SPHERE instrument paper. Dohlen et al. 2008 is the IRDIS design-and-performance paper. No magnitude system is stated on the filter page.
